title: Claude Code Replaced My n8n Workflow
description:
Comment "SYSTEM" on my Instagram (link in the channel description) and I'll send you the full prompt to set this up.

Claude Code just changed how I think about automation. Instead of building complicated multi-step workflows in n8n, Zapier or Make, you just describe what you want and Claude Code builds the entire system for you.

I told Claude Code to act as my social media manager. It built a full system inside Notion: viral ideas that are working right now, content gaps, performance analysis, and a complete content pipeline with scripts and optimal posting windows.

Then I connected it to my content engine, which finds even more viral ideas and automatically turns them into full 4K image carousels that auto-post to Instagram and LinkedIn.

No complicated workflows. No manual node dragging. Just describe it, and it builds.

#claudecode #aiautomation #n8n #contentmarketing #ecommerce
